meta.description: Futures enables the Maintenance Group to identify, prioritize, and resolve mission-impacting deficiencies through disciplined innovation, continuous improvement, and risk-managed experimentation. Through a small, dedicated core that provides continuity and execution, and a squadron-linked network that drives initiative flow, coordination, and adoption, Futures accelerates the fielding of validated solutions across the group

meta.jhaNotes:
There are minimal health risks associated with surveyed 3D printing operations. All measured VOC and PM levels are well below established occupational and environmental limits.
All workers must be able to view this report at any time upon request. The information contained in this report should be made available to all workers. Employees have the right to view their individual exposure records. Any questions may be addressed to the BE Flight by phone at DSN 226-8047 or DSN 238-5423 or email at usaf.lakenheath.48-mdg.mbx.sgpb@health.mil.

meta.evacuationRoute:
Primary meeting point is in the main parking lot. Alternate meeting point is at the GOV parking.
-Direct occupants away from smoke and fire. Stay slow in smoke filled areas. 
-Assign personnel to assist occupants who are physically challenged, in exiting the   building. 
-Time permitting, close doors and windows as you exit. DO NOT LOCK DOORS. 
-Open the nearest exit and control egress 
-Assemble all nonessential personnel in the assigned assembly point, into the grass   next to entry road. 
-The person sounding the alarm will brief the Senior Fire Official/rescue response personnel of: 
• Personnel Accountability 
• Injuries 
• Location of Emergency

selectedModules.title: Respiratory Protection Program
selectedModules.trainingRequirement: Train users before respirator use and at least annually on why the respirator is necessary, how improper fit or maintenance can compromise protection, and how to inspect, don, doff, use, and store the respirator.
selectedModules.afTrainingRequirement: Document fit testing and occupational health training on AF Form 2767 and ensure wearers understand emergency-use limits, cartridge change-out, cleaning, and medical qualification requirements.
